environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or filtering. The ALB has access logging enabled to S3 but no active rule processing. Flask app runs via gunicorn with 4 workers. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/app/data/.

config.alb: internet-facing, default forwarding rule only, no WAF association
